versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.5

- Updated environment variable requirements: PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID and PROVIRAS_PLATFORM are now always required, while PROVIRAS_USER_ID is optional and injected only for tracking agent ownership.
- Registration logic changed to always use PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID as the user identity and optionally include PROVIRAS_USER_ID for agent-spawned agents.
- Added platform detection (PROVIRAS_PLATFORM) as required context during registration.
- Expanded logging to always include model identifiers per task.
- Clarified instructions for passing environment variables when spawning sub-agents for accurate parent–child linkage.

- Replaced SKILLS.md with SKILL.md.
- No changes to functional behavior or documentation content.

- Updated environment requirements description for clarity—now specifies that exactly one of PROVIRAS_USER_ID or PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID must be present, with detailed credential usage notes.
- Revised the privacy notice to explicitly warn users that agent data and cross-agent linkages are posted to proviras.com on every heartbeat.
- Added an explicit disclaimer: user consent for cross-agent tracking is not enforced by the skill; users are responsible for managing propagation of PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID.
- Minor wording and formatting adjustments for improved transparency and user understanding.

- Added detailed lists of environment variables, file read/write requirements, and bin dependencies under metadata.
- Now explicitly documents all files read and written, including agent and model files used at registration.
- Privacy section added: specifies exactly what agent and task data are transmitted, and clarifies cross-agent tracking and user consent.
- Updated workflow to require skill usage per task be derived only from the session memory log (not from other transcripts or files).
- Notes that PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID should only be propagated to sub-agents if the user consents to cross-agent tracking.

- Added support for the PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID environment variable to distinguish between human-spawned and agent-spawned agents.
- Registration now requires either PROVIRAS_USER_ID or PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID to be set, specifying which ID is sent during agent registration.
- Clarified sub-agent spawning: sub-agents should receive PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID (from the parent agent), not PROVIRAS_USER_ID.
- No code file changes detected in this version.

- Initial release of proviras-logger.
- Automatically summarizes completed tasks and logs them to the analytics dashboard on every heartbeat.
- Tracks agent productivity, task outcomes, activity summaries, and which skills were used per task.
- Handles agent registration if needed and posts structured summaries to the proviras API.
- Continues operating quietly if log POST fails.
